Ethan (Sales): Also filing a request with Product to tighten rollout filters (ticket EXP-ROLL-901).
Maya (Finance): Approved. Post as goodwill credit to GL 5230-promos. Add audit note: "misapplied by lb-0426".

BillingBot: Credit memo CM-7401 queued; will apply on next run.
Rhea (Customer Success): I'll send confirmation to customer: "We've moved the $1,200 promo to your next invoice (INV-80220) as a goodwill credit."
